work.description: Bull CLXXVII (GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS LF39075) erects the see of Iulia Caesarea (Algiers), suffragan of Aix, under royal nomination, executor the internuncio Garibaldi; LF39107 → LF39116 across a mark LF39110 and running title LF39113; LF39175 → LF39184 across own provenance LF39178 and running title LF39181; across page numbers LF39250, LF39322 and running title LF39390; the OCR garble epieiovuter LF39247 remains literal; complete closing with sanction, dated quarto idus augusti 1838 = 10 August 1838. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS at LF39075–39075; the source closing at LF39425–39428 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem anno incarnationis dominicae millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octavo, quarto idus augusti, pontificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
